The announcement of Jeffery's death was quickly followed by tributes from her former castmates including Milo Manheim, Trevor Tordjman and Chandler Kinney. Manheim, who played Zed in the franchise, wrote, "The sweetest person I have ever met. I love you." Trevor Tordjman, who starred as Bucky, said Jeffery's "energy and spirit" would stay with him.

Jeffery's death follows a number of high-profile celebrity deaths in 2026, including Dolly Parton, Tim Curry and Hayden Panettiere.
